decision.sourceSpan: elektrophile Substitution: Reaktionstyp und Reaktionsmechanismus der Halogenierung am Aromaten
decision.rationale: AUTHOR proposal: current official Q2.3 commonGK/LK operator is halogenation reaction type and mechanism. Existing17ab with mesomeric-benzene prior carries the generic EAS model and supplied-Br+ case; supplied-NO2+ error transfer does not require nitrating-reagent/condition knowledge. The existing3dbd partial sigma-complex contribution is retained without making its whole LK-tagged unit a GK admission. Mixedb98 whole nitration competence remains valid under its actual LK occurrence; it is not the common whole carrier.
